scope: All locally saved official MySQL Server report/index Version fields; no severity/status/date exclusion
rules: Category must equal MySQL Server or start with MySQL Server:
Only literal full patch tokens 8.0.32/33/34/35 create items; no expansion to all four versions
Explicitly written interval endpoints are retained separately; interval interiors are not expanded
A plus/downstream range does not create other target patch versions
8.0.34/35 permits one explicitly labelled same-branch shorthand item for 8.0.35
Product/build suffixes are retained and flagged; matching patch number does not prove runtime build equivalence
When report body exists, raw detail Version and Category are checked against parsed values; otherwise official index evidence is retained with a missing-body gap
Only frozen local sources are counted; this does not claim completeness of the live official website
why_previous_563_was_incomplete: Previous count was restricted to 2733 already-selected candidate report-version pairs, excluding other statuses/preparation groups and 68 index-only reports. New scope is drawn from the full available official index/detail material.
